overview: You looked at the letter after the talk and copied the place and the two days. You did not copy a number of the dead. You kept the line that Tyrone was trained in the English manner, and you left the rest folded.

parties.name: William Sly
parties.context: Had brought the letter. He was not in this stretch. The sheet was his cousin's.

assets.name: the cousin's letter
assets.disposition: Copied the place and the two days
